newsitem.title: USA: Baxter shares up on strong Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Baxter shares up on strong Q4 results.

text.p: Shares in Baxter International Inc jumped 3-3/4 to 46-1/8 Thursday on Wall Street enthusiasm over the company's fourth-quarter financial results.

"Investors are obviously encouraged that the company's top-line growth has shown a strong upturn following a sluggish performance in the third quarter," said Bear Stearns healthcare industry analyst Frederick Wise. "Results were pretty strong, despite the impact of foreign currencies."
The healthcare products manufacturer reported fourth-quarter operating profits of $0.58 per share, compared with year-ago results of $0.54 per share.
Quarterly sales were $1.49 billion, up 10 percent from a year ago. Sales would have been $30 million higher if not for currency translations, said the Deerfield, Ill.-based company.
